name: Hakuna (Hakuna GmbH)
what: Embedded product-protection insurance (AppleCare-style warranty extensions and damage cover) that retailers and e-commerce merchants sell at checkout via API.
homonym_note: Google News for 'hakuna' is dominated by 'Hakuna Matata' and Kenyan news; unrelated.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026) and on the archived visionaries.vc/portfolio page from 2023; Visionaries Club led the Dec 2021 pre-seed and joined the Sept 2022 seed as an existing investor.
membership.quote: Hakuna’s €1.5 million pre-seed round was led by Visionaries Club

entry.quote: Hakuna’s €1.5 million pre-seed round was led by Visionaries Club

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "hakuna" insurance -> Dec 2021 pre-seed and Sept 2022 seed only (tech.eu, TFN); later hits are homonyms (Hakuna Matata, Kenyan news) through 2026-09
googlenews: "hakuna" embedded insurance -> only the Sept 2022 seed (tech.eu, TFN)
company site: hellohakuna.com/press lists no funding news for 2023-2026
notes: Visionaries led the pre-seed (tech.eu 2021-12-10, with a quote from Visionaries founding partner Sebastian Pollok) and followed on in the EUR 4M Earlybird-led seed of 2022-09-21 ('existing investors Visionaries Club, Discovery Ventures ...', tech.eu). The seed is named Seed and is below $5M, so it does not graduate the row; no Series A found in nearly four years since. HQ: the current legal notice gives Hakuna GmbH, Albrecht-Dürer-Strasse 18, 82008 Unterhaching (Munich suburb), while the company is registered at Berlin-Charlottenburg (HRB 233545 B) and 2021-2022 press called it Berlin-based (eu-startups in Sept 2022 already said 'Munich-based Hakuna'); Unterhaching recorded as the current municipality, judge may prefer Munich as the metro. Founding year not stated in any source (the company was a 'fledgling startup' at the Dec 2021 pre-seed). Focus: embedded insurance (a licensed broker under §34d GewO) read as Fintech & Payments, as the Insify row.
